base: A source of control becomes much harder to protect once the rule, threat, secret, or consequence behind compliance is out in the open.
business: The two concerns arrive in the same decision; work with the point they now share.
shadow: Because both concerns are active at once, acting on one can obscure what the other still needs.
arcApplying: The two concerns become harder to separate as exactness approaches.
arcSeparating: The fused emphasis begins to loosen after exactness.

readerCopy.body: A source of control becomes much harder to protect once the rule, threat, secret, or consequence behind compliance is out in the open. When Pluto conjoins Lilith, control and refusal intensify together, bringing the source of power behind an unequal arrangement into clearer view. There may be far less willingness to keep cooperating once the price of cooperation is obvious. The balance can change quickly after the old pressure stops working. The strongest change removes the source of control instead of rebuilding the same control from the other side.
